test_HuggingFaceBucketWriter_init: test the HuggingFaceBucketWriter class initialization with bucket and local_working_dir parameters
test_HuggingFaceBucketWriter_upload_file: test the HuggingFaceBucketWriter upload_files method to upload parquet files to a HuggingFace Hub bucket
test_HuggingFaceBucketWriter_overwrite: test the HuggingFaceBucketWriter overwrite mode to delete existing bucket files before uploading new ones
test_HuggingFaceBucketWriter_close: test the HuggingFaceBucketWriter close method to upload remaining open files without creating a commit
test_HuggingFaceBucketWriter_round_trip: test the HuggingFaceBucketWriter and ParquetReader round-trip by writing documents and reading them back
